claims.value: WebWorld is a large-scale open-web world model series for training and evaluating web agents, trained on 1M+ real-world web interaction trajectories. WebWorld-14B is based on Qwen3-14B. It supports long-horizon simulation (30+ steps) and multi-format state representations (A11y Tree, HTML, XML, Markdown, natural language).
claims.evidence: WebWorld is a large-scale open-web world model series for training and evaluating web agents. It is trained on 1M+ real-world web interaction trajectories
